'''Otherspace''' was a [[Tube Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. An enclosed [[Complex]] similar to [[The Channel (swoopchasing)|The Channel]], it was a spacious labyrinth with multiple paths. Riders used [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] tracking lights to maneuver through dips, turns, and straightaways. The [[swoopchaser]]s required [[Infrared goggles/Legends|infrared goggles]] to see the tracking lights and move through the Complex. Otherspace could be augmented by [[ion flare]] pits and [[repulsor buoy]] traps.<ref name="BSS" />
